in_sanskrit.name: किरन्मयी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has a body as radiant as a ray of light. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kirana' which means 'ray of light' and the suffix 'maya' which means 'one who has'. Hence, the name Kiranmayi translates to 'one who has a body as radiant as a ray of light'.

in_hindi.name: किरनमायी
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has a body as radiant as the Sun. The name Kiranmayi in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kirana' which means 'ray of light' and the suffix 'maya' which means 'one who has'. The long meaning translates to 'One who has a body as radiant as a ray of light or the Sun'.
